summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on USS Reliable (SP-352), a boat or ship that the United States Navy at least considered for service during World War I. She was assigned the section patrol number 352, but no record of her characteristics or service has been found.
one_line: USS Reliable (SP-352) was a vessel the US Navy considered for World War I service, but no records of her characteristics or service survive.
